title: VASP Si: PAO bands, non-spin-polarized and spin-polarized
summary: Bulk silicon from VASP (PAW): the PAO Hamiltonian on the POTCAR pseudo-orbitals and the all-electron tables (3S 3P 3D 4S 4P 4D), and its band structure, from a non-spin-polarized and a spin-polarized nscf run. Needs your own VASP runs and POTCAR.

steps.label: Si bands from the non-spin-polarized run
steps.note: needs the VASP runs of nscf_nspin1/ (vasprun.xml, WAVECAR, POTCAR); writes output_nspin1/ and Si_nspin1_VASP.png

steps.label: Si bands from the spin-polarized run
steps.note: needs the VASP runs of nscf_nspin2/ (vasprun.xml, WAVECAR, POTCAR); writes output_nspin2/ and Si_nspin2_VASP.png
